sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A sparking scale from a Treasure Carp.
To the average person it is just a beautiful scale. But there are some who exalt a certain "master", who consider these scales among the most precious things in the world. For this reason, collecting them could be worthwhile.

sections.heading: Locations
sections.text:
Ashina Castle
Ashina Castle: there's a Treasure Carp in the moat below the bridge.
Ashina Castle: one lays at the bottom of the same lake. (requires Mibu Breathing Technique)
Senpou Temple
Temple Grounds: there are two Treasure Carps in the pond past the Sculptor's Idol.
Sunken Valley
Gun Fort: there are two Treasure Carps in the lake before the Riven Cave Sculptor's Idol. (requires Mibu Breathing Technique)
Gun Fort: one lays at the bottom of the same lake.
Ashina Depths
Mibu Village: two are sold by the Exiled Memorial Mob for 500 500 each.
Mibu Village: one is found downstream from the Exiled Memorial Mob in the shallows of the river, guarded by an Interior Ministry Agent.
Water Mill: there's a Treasure Carp at the end of the river from the Sculptor's Idol.
Water Mill: five are dropped by the Head Priest after the Water of the Palace transforms him into a Palace Noble.
Fountainhead Palace
Mibu Manor: three are found in the same room with the chest containing the Water of the Palace.
Vermillion Bridge: there are seven Treasure Carps in the large lake. (requires defeating Okami Leader Shizu)
Vermillion Bridge: five Scales lay at the bottom of the large lake.
Feeding Grounds: one is awarded by the Attendant of the Great Carp after feeding a Precious Bait to the Great Coloured Carp and three more are given if another Precious Bait is feeded. If not given prior, these four Carp Scales can be retrieved from the corpse of the Attendant.
Hirata Estate
Dragonspring - Hirata Estate: there are four Treasure Carps in the river. (at least one requires Mibu Breathing Technique)
Dragonspring - Hirata Estate: on the bank of the river by a stone, dropping to the left from the bridge upon arrival, opposite side of Pot Noble Harunaga.
Bamboo Thicket Slope: there's a Treasure Carp up the river to the left past the Sculptor's Idol.
Bamboo Thicket Slope: there's another Treasure Carp in the same river underwater. (requires Mibu Breathing Technique)

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Used as currency to buy items from Pot Noble Harunaga in Hirata Estate or from Pot Noble Koremori in the Fountainhead Palace.
There are 42 Treasure Carp Scale available per game cycle.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- At least 18 Scales are needed to purchase three Lapis Lazuli and unlock the "Master of the Prosthetic" trophy.
- It's necessary to spend 5 Scales for the Floating Passage to unlock the "Height of Technique" trophy.
